data.name: Antarah
data.gender_notes: Antarah is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word 'antar', meaning 'to fight'. The name Antarah is a name of strength and courage, evoking images of warriors and defenders. The name Antarah carries the meaning “Valiant, Brave” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Antarah usually hope their child will grow to embody valiant, brave and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Antarah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Valiant, Brave.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Antarah total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

in_urdu.name: عنترہ

in_pashto.name: عنترة

data.cultural_impact: The name Antarah has been prominent in Islamic literature, particularly in the poetry of pre-Islamic Arab societies. It has been mentioned in the Epics of Antar, folktales about the legendary hero Antar ibn Shaddad. He was known for his chivalry, heroism, and self-sacrifice. Antarah is a symbol of valor, strength, and loyalty in the Arab culture.
data.spiritual_significance: In Islamic spirituality, the name Antarah signifies the inner fight that each believer must undertake in adhering to the teachings of Islam. The name symbolizes the spiritual warrior within each person, striving to purify their soul and submit to Allah's will. It is a reminder that 'jihad', or the struggle towards spiritual growth and righteousness, is a daily effort that requires courage, determination, and selflessness. thereby, the name 'Antarah' holds great significance not only as a symbol of valor and bravery in the Islamic society but also as a symbol of spiritual quest and struggle towards self-improvement and closeness to Allah.
